sidecar_call:codexGoalClear.item: Clear the Codex goal of the thread.

sidecar_call:codexGoalGet.item: Read the current Codex goal of the thread.

sidecar_call:codexGoalSet.item: Set a Codex goal for the thread.

sidecar_call:message.item: Notification carrying one streamed agent message (ours is the sessionEvent notification).

sidecar_call:queryError.item: Notification that a query failed; ours has no separate queryError, the failure arrives as an event and a live state.

sidecar_call:codexMcpConsentDeliveryFail.item: Notification that a Codex MCP consent answer could not be delivered to Codex, so the card can come back.

sidecar_call:sessionEventNotification.item: Notification carrying a stored session event for the app to save (ours is sessionEvent).

sidecar_call:deliverSessionEvent.item: Sidecar resends an event the app has not confirmed after a reconnect (ours is deliverEvent).

sidecar_call:sessionStatusNotification.item: Notification that the working status of a chat changed (ours is liveState).

sidecar_call:sessionStateNotification.item: Notification with the live state of a chat (ours is liveState).

sidecar_call:fastModeUnavailableNotifica.item: Notification that fast mode is unavailable for the account (ours is liveState.fastModeAvailable).

sidecar_call:shellEnvCaptureNotification.item: Notification reporting the result of a login-shell environment capture; ours has no such notification and keeps the result inside the sidecar.

sidecar_call:exitPlanMode.item: Sidecar asks the app to approve leaving plan mode (ours is requestInteraction with a plan approval).

sidecar_call:askUserQuestion.item: Sidecar asks the user a question from the agent (ours is requestInteraction with a question).

sidecar_call:codexMcpElicitation.item: Sidecar asks the user to answer a Codex MCP form (ours is requestInteraction).

sidecar_call:codexPermissionApproval.item: Sidecar asks the user to grant a Codex permission (ours is requestInteraction).

sidecar_call:toolApproval.item: Sidecar asks the user to approve a tool call (ours is requestInteraction).

sidecar_call:getDiff.item: Sidecar asks the app for the workspace diff for the GetWorkspaceDiff tool (ours is getWorkspaceDiff).

sidecar_call:diffComment.item: Sidecar asks the app to add diff comments for the DiffComment tool (ours is addDiffComments).

sidecar_call:enterPlanModeNotification.item: Notification that the agent entered plan mode by itself, so the app records the new mode.

sidecar_call:checkpointCreated.item: Notification that a start or end checkpoint of a turn exists, with the changed-file summary (ours is the checkpoint event).

sidecar_call:keepAwake.item: Notification asking the app to keep the Mac awake while agents work (ours is an app-side setting driven by live state).

sidecar_call:remoteControlPairedDevicesC.note: A backend name of the phone relay: pairing a device and the paired device list. Remote control is D019's claude.ai route.

sidecar_call:query.item: Query: the app starts a new agent turn with the message, attachments and chat settings (ours is sendMessage).

sidecar_call:steer.item: Steer request: the app sends a message into a running turn instead of starting a new one (ours is sendMessage with delivery steer).

sidecar_call:updatePermissionMode.item: Switch the permission mode of a live chat between plan and default (ours is updateConfig with planMode).

sidecar_call:setClaudeEditAutoAccept.item: Let the live Claude session accept file edits without asking for the rest of the session (ours is updateConfig with requireToolApproval).

sidecar_call:resetGenerator.item: Reset the agent generator of a chat so the next message starts fresh (ours is resetAgent).

sidecar_call:setVerboseLogging.item: Turn verbose logging on or off in the sidecar (ours is setLogLevel).

sidecar_call:setInternalUser.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.

sidecar_call:setAppLoggerUrl.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.

sidecar_call:setPostHogDistinctId.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.

sidecar_call:setExternalLoggingDisabled.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.

sidecar_call:setModelCatalog.item: Push the model catalog to the sidecar; ours is the other way round, the sidecar owns the model list (deliberate, no visible difference).

sidecar_call:claudeAuth.item: Claude sign-in request: the app starts the Claude login flow through the sidecar (ours is startAgentLogin).

sidecar_call:codexAuth.item: Codex sign-in request: the app starts the Codex login flow through the sidecar (ours is startAgentLogin).

sidecar_call:codexCloudAuthStart.note: A backend name of Conductor's hosted computers or its cloud sign-in. Our cloud is D018's.

sidecar_call:codexCloudAuthFinish.note: A backend name of Conductor's hosted computers or its cloud sign-in. Our cloud is D018's.

sidecar_call:cursorCloudAuthStart.note: A backend name of Conductor's hosted computers or its cloud sign-in. Our cloud is D018's.

sidecar_call:cursorCloudAuthFinish.note: A backend name of Conductor's hosted computers or its cloud sign-in. Our cloud is D018's.

sidecar_call:cursorCloudAuthCancel.note: A backend name of Conductor's hosted computers or its cloud sign-in. Our cloud is D018's.

sidecar_call:fetchAvailableMCP.item: List the MCP servers available to an agent in a workspace, with their status (ours is listMcpServers).

sidecar_call:fetchSlashCommands.item: List slash commands and skills of an agent in a workspace (ours is listSlashCommands).

sidecar_call:fetchPreWorkspaceCompletion.item: List slash commands and skills before any workspace exists, from a cached snapshot, for the new-workspace composer.

sidecar_call:listAcpModels.item: List the models of an ACP agent (ours is listModels).

sidecar_call:fetchAcpSessionConfigOption.item: Fetch the per-chat config options of an ACP agent beyond the model.

sidecar_call:syncAcpSessionModel.item: Tell an ACP agent which model a chat uses when a saved chat is reloaded.

sidecar_call:setAcpSessionConfigOption.item: Set one config option of an ACP session.

sidecar_call:listCodexModels.item: List the Codex models (ours is listModels).

sidecar_call:warmShellEnv.item: Warm the login-shell environment for a folder so the first turn starts faster; ours captures it at sidecar start and on warmAgent.

sidecar_call:persistedSessionEvent.item: App confirms an event is stored so the sidecar may drop it from its outbox (ours is the eventPersisted notification).

sidecar_call:remoteControlChanges.item: Notification that Remote Control changes arrived from the remote side (ours is part of the Remote Control status).

sidecar_call:remoteControlStart.item: Start Remote Control for a chat so claude.ai can drive it (a different mechanism than Conductor's phone relay).

sidecar_call:remoteControlStop.item: Stop Remote Control for a chat.

sidecar_call:remoteControlStatus.item: Ask for the Remote Control connection status of a chat.

sidecar_call:remoteControlCreatePairingO.note: A backend name of the phone relay: pairing a device and the paired device list. Remote control is D019's claude.ai route.

sidecar_call:remoteControlClearPairingOf.note: A backend name of the phone relay: pairing a device and the paired device list. Remote control is D019's claude.ai route.

sidecar_call:remoteControlListPairedDevi.note: A backend name of the phone relay: pairing a device and the paired device list. Remote control is D019's claude.ai route.

sidecar_call:remoteControlRemovePairedDe.note: A backend name of the phone relay: pairing a device and the paired device list. Remote control is D019's claude.ai route.

sidecar_call:codexRollback.item: Codex rollback: resume a Codex thread only up to a chosen message (ours is resume.atNativeMessageId).

sidecar_call:codexCompact.item: Codex compact: shrink the Codex thread history through thread/compact/start, started by the /compact command.

sidecar_call:contextUsage.item: Ask for the context window use and plan usage of a chat (ours is getContextUsage).

sidecar_call:acpOneShotPrompt.item: Run one short prompt through an ACP agent for a chat title or branch name, then discard the session.

sidecar_call:cursorOneShotPrompt.item: Run one short prompt through the Cursor agent for a chat title or branch name, then discard the session.

sidecar_call:answerUserQuestion.item: App answers a question card from the agent (ours is answerInteraction).

sidecar_call:startAgentationProxy.item: Start a small proxy that adds the page-annotation toolbar to the in-app browser preview; ours does this in the app, not the sidecar.

sidecar_call:listLocalhostPorts.item: List the ports that listen on localhost; ours reads them with lsof in the shell instead of asking the sidecar (deliberate, shell owns it).

sidecar_call:getHarnessVersions.item: Ask for the installed versions of the agent programs (ours is getAgentInstalls).

sidecar_call:harnessVersionsNotification.item: Notification that the installed agent program versions changed (ours is agentInstallsChanged).

sidecar_call:crashTest.note: A backend name for Conductor's analytics, crash reporting, app logger or staff tools.
